findings.title: Fix contradictory help exit wording
findings.text: The exit line contradicts itself: it says `req canon` "never gates" and in the same sentence describes `--fail-on-flag` exiting 1. Reword it so the default mode is report-only and the opt-in is the only mode that can fail, matching the behavior this PR adds.
findings.existing_code:
exit: 0 diagnostics reported — not a pass: it reports, and it never gates; with `--fail-on-flag`,
0 means no pin is flagged and 1 means at least one is; 3 a registry or claim file that cannot be
read (or is NOT JUDGED); 2 usage, including `--fill` and `--verify`.
